title: Forward field copy of 44-byte records
summary: Recovered 0x4b31e0 range algorithm: forward sequential field assignments, preserving bytes 25..27, returning destination end. Original custom register ABI uses ECX/EDX and caller-cleaned stack; GCC oracle adapter models it with regparm(3) and an unused EAX argument. Caller application_frame stores returned end at container +0x34.
test_description: Direct original comparison across 16 byte-pattern seeds, null empty range, valid one-past empty range, single and multi-record copies, self-copy and both overlap directions; compare every backing byte, return pointer, untouched padding and bytes outside destination. Install test FS and check restoration after each original call.
known_limits: Record and field semantic names remain unresolved.
Requires valid forward whole-record ranges and accessible storage; malformed endpoints, address wrap and invalid pointers are outside the portable C++ contract.
Tests cover aligned records and record-aligned overlap, not unaligned or partial-record aliasing.
No byte matching or whole-game recovery claimed.
